shabad.source_english: Codes of Conduct and Other Panthic Sources

verses.gurmukhi: ਖ਼ਲਕ ਖਾਲਿਕ ਕੀ ਜਾਣ ਕੇ ਖ਼ਲਕ ਦੁਖਾਵੈ ਨਾਹਿ
verses.translit_en: khhalak khaalik kee jaan ke khhalak dhukhaavai naah

en.bdb: Regard the creation as that of the Creator, one should not exploit the creation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਖ਼ਲਕ ਦੁਖੈ ਨੰਦ ਲਾਲ ਜੀ ਖਾਲਿਕ ਕੋਪੈ ਤਾਹਿ। (੪੯)
verses.translit_en: khhalak dhukhai na(n)dh laal jee khaalik kopai taah| (49)

en.bdb: If the creation is hurt, Lal Jee, the Creator is enraged.(49)
